selection_rule.statement: Round-robin over problem types in declaration order. Pass one takes the first case of every problem type, pass two the second, and so on until ten are selected.
selection_rule.why: It maximises problem-type coverage without a seed or a tie-break, so the selection is reproducible from the fixture module alone. Taking the first ten in declaration order would have yielded six logic problem types instead of eight.

signature_constraint.rule: each selected case identity is distinct and appears exactly once
signature_constraint.why: Backlog section 8.2 requires 50 task signatures across the combined pair set. The 60 historical coding pairs supply 30, so the 20 fresh pairs must supply 20 with zero margin.

execution_protocol.successful_side: the same case with no override
execution_protocol.failure_must_be: task-semantic, that is the acceptance decision reports required verification failed, never an infrastructure error
execution_protocol.verifiers: the built-in registry with z3-solver and sympy present; 57 of 65 verifiers available, registry snapshot 44b01e0c86a993bc01c1d06f28973db76c4383a30da539ff1d8ca3841c0a155c

determinism_protocol.measured_before_freezing: Recompiling a persisted trajectory reproduces its manifest byte for byte. A fresh independent run of the same case does not, because event occurred_at values come from a wall clock and the compilation identity is a digest over event content.
determinism_protocol.consequence: Byte-identical recompilation is verified the way ExperienceCompilerService already defines it: a persisted manifest that differs from deterministic recompilation raises rather than being overwritten. The trajectory is the immutable evidence; a re-run is a different trajectory, exactly as two C3 runs of one task are two outcomes.
determinism_protocol.compilation_created_at: derived as the minimum event occurred_at of the trajectory, in cognitive_os.domains.learning.build_compilation, not read from a clock at compile time
determinism_protocol.compilation_identity: uuid5 over the trajectory digest, so identity follows the evidence rather than the clock
determinism_protocol.distinction_from_legacy: The 60 historical coding pairs are marked legacy_recompilation_unavailable because their manifests carry a wall-clock created_at that cannot be reproduced at all. The fresh pairs are verified by actual recompilation, which is the stronger of the two modes.

group_policy.overlap_with_query_groups: none; no fresh case shares a group with any of the 30 coding repository groups

rights.source: project-owned domain fixtures, already released under the repository licence
